answer: What keeps this honest is cross-chain identity proof via Jumper, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. Cloning 579 keys multiplies the price 579-fold: 68901 POA locked, or 7527 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One nebula of signal, one ledge of cost, one grove of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
